Manifest.Name: 更好的顾客库存 | Better Customer Stock
Manifest.Author: CloudforTree
Manifest.Description: 按顾客调整出货概率、货物数量和分类权重。档位为 −100 到 +100，0 沿用原版。「特殊商品设置」可调整共用固定名额的货物权重或指定数量。 Adjust each customer's stock chance, quantity, and category weights. Sliders range from −100 to +100, with 0 using vanilla behavior. Use Special Goods Settings to adjust weights or set exact quantities for groups with a shared number of slots.
